name: Abigail Mercer

Abigail Mercer (LN) — President and Principal Financier

Abigail is an accomplished northern banker whose family accumulated considerable wealth financing maritime commerce before the civil war. She recognized the potential of Blackvein's mineral wealth early and invested heavily in establishing reliable financial services on the frontier. Mercer is cautious, exacting, and deeply concerned with preserving the company's reputation for honoring its obligations. Nevertheless, she believes that prospectors who borrow recklessly must accept the consequences when their claims fail to produce.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 45 (source excerpt; may be partial)
